messages:
mira_design: quick accessibility check — noticed a weird focus 'ghosting' effect in the model list when you tab quickly. On dark theme the ring sometimes leaves a faint duplicate on the previous row :eyes:

jon_eng_ui: hmm, I saw that too during the high-density table pass. Might be related to our CSS transition on :focus + transform on the row.

kelly_accessibility: can you repro steps? is it VoiceOver/NVDA specific or happening with keyboard only? Also need a contrast grab — is the focus stroke below 3:1?

mira_design: repro steps: open Console -> Models tab -> switch to Compact rows -> tab rapidly through rows. Happens with keyboard only (no screen reader). On mac, VoiceOver also announces the focused row twice sometimes. Dark theme focus stroke is 2.6:1 vs bg.

jon_eng_ui: likely we added a subtle scale transform on :focus to emphasize the row. That could cause repaint lag and a visual duplicate because we animate both outline and transform.

kelly_accessibility: yep transforms + outline can cause the element to re-paint and leave visual artifacts in some browsers. Two quick fixes: remove the transform on keyboard focus, and make the focus indicator a non-blurry solid stroke with sufficient contrast.

jon_eng_ui: proposed CSS to try:
```css
.row:focus {
  transform: none; /* remove scale on keyboard focus */
  outline: 3px solid var(--focus-accent);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}
```

mira_design: that looks good. Also saw another nit: our skiplink jumps to the table header but the header is under the sticky topbar so the first row gets hidden. Users complained it 'disappears' after skip.

raj_prod: we hit this in prod too when topbar height changes during responsive collapse. Adding scroll-padding-top or scroll-margin-top on the target anchor usually fixes it.

kelly_accessibility: exact fix: set `:target { scroll-margin-top: var(--topbar-height); }` and ensure the skiplink target is the row container (not the header cell). Add an automated Lighthouse check for this.

jon_eng_ui: ok will implement both: remove keyboard-only transforms + stronger outline + scroll-margin-top on anchors. Also will add a small change to focus ring color for dark theme to meet 4.5:1 contrast against surface.

mira_design: also please add a quick screen reader QA: VoiceOver + NVDA run through Compact view, Tab + Shift-Tab across rows, and Skiplink. I can write the test steps.

kelly_accessibility: I'll write the QA script and add to the console accessibility checklist. One more thing — when a cell is empty we sometimes get a duplicate focusable region (empty cell + row). Let's ensure only the row is tabbable and cells are not unless interactive.

jon_eng_ui: good catch. We'll audit tabindex usage and replace `tabindex="0"` on non-interactive cells with `aria-hidden="true"` or remove tabindex.

aria_bot: accessibility-linter: automated check idea created (#A11Y-118). Rules: no transforms on :focus, focus indicator contrast >= 4.5:1, scroll-margin-top on anchors, no redundant tabindex on non-interactive cells.

raj_prod: timeline?

jon_eng_ui: I'll open a small PR today with the CSS change and a regression test for the tab-cycle. kelly, can you review the QA steps?

kelly_accessibility: yes, will review and then run VoiceOver/NVDA passes. If all good, mark as resolved. :thumbsup:

mira_design: thanks team — this will make the dense table much more usable for keyboard + SR users.
